observation: issues open as of the observed date

limitations.title: Tool-call fuzz: finish the rejected-span oracle failures left at the #3 merge
limitations.impact: A plain tool-call fuzz campaign stops at the first rejected-span oracle panic, so the default `make fuzz` fails there.

limitations.title: Audit the unreviewed #3 stage-3 commits and close the F14/F19 rule's known limits
limitations.impact: Some stage-3 commits of the tool-call work were merged without an audit, and the known limits of the F14/F19 rule remain open.

limitations.title: Tool-call recovery: restarted DeepSeek-V3.1 sections cost quadratic work and super-quadratic time
limitations.impact: A turn with many restarted DeepSeek-V3.1 sections costs quadratic work and super-quadratic time.

limitations.title: Tool-call recovery: repair search under-charges work on mutated free-form-item turns (seconds for 192 bytes)
limitations.impact: One 192-byte mutated turn takes about 5 s in a release build, so the default `make fuzz` exceeds its timeout on `tool-call-ref`; the CLI and MCP sized budget ends it explicitly in 0.3 s.

limitations.title: Tool-call recovery: add the pythonic.v1 dialect and pythonic codec
limitations.impact: `pythonic.v1` is not built in, so its call markup is not recovered as a tool call.

limitations.title: Tool-call recovery: add the glm-4.5.v1 dialect and kv-pairs codec
limitations.impact: `glm-4.5.v1` is not built in, so its call markup is not recovered as a tool call.

limitations.title: Tool-call recovery: add the gemma3-tool-code.v1 dialect
limitations.impact: `gemma3-tool-code.v1` is not built in, so its call markup is not recovered as a tool call.

limitations.title: Tool-call recovery: streaming recognizer (ToolCallStream, stable-prefix events, CLI --stream, MCP progress)
limitations.impact: There is no `ToolCallStream`, no stable-prefix events, no CLI `--stream` option and no MCP progress reporting for recovery.

limitations.title: Tool-call recovery: reassemble provider streaming events (Anthropic SSE tool_use, OpenAI tool_calls deltas)
limitations.impact: Anthropic SSE `tool_use` and OpenAI `tool_calls` delta streams are not reassembled into a turn.

limitations.title: Tool-call recovery: special-token-stripped dialect variants (*-stripped.v1)
limitations.impact: Dialect variants for output whose special tokens were stripped (`*-stripped.v1`) are not built in.
